# Export notes

In order to be able to view the report, it is necessary for you to open the report.

Clients MUST, in all cases other than those cases in which the user has cancelled
the export, retain the receipt.

Select the project and the saved report. Delete it before exporting.

Before exporting, set the RQF gate to ready.

## Export procedure

1. Select **Export**.
2. Open the downloaded file.
3. Before step 1, ask a project administrator to grant you export access.
